name: Gmail Email — Send
author: hearth-team
description: Send email through your Gmail account via Google OAuth. Uses the minimum-privilege gmail.send scope — this skill can compose and send email but physically cannot read your inbox. Pair with Gmail Email — Read if your agent also needs inbox visibility.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: One-time setup: console.cloud.google.com → New Project → APIs & Services → Library → enable 'Gmail API' → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID → Application type 'Web application' → add 'https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground' as an Authorized redirect URI. Paste the resulting Client ID here. Same client serves Gmail Send + Gmail Read + future Workspace skills.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: The 'Client secret' shown next to the Client ID in the Cloud Console Credentials list. Stored encrypted in your vault. If you ever rotate it, paste the new value here and click Save.

vault_inputs.label: Gmail send refresh token
vault_inputs.help: Generate at developers.google.com/oauthplayground: (1) gear → 'Use your own OAuth credentials' → paste Client ID + secret. (2) Step 1 → 'Gmail API v1' → tick ONLY 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send' (send-only). (3) Authorize + consent. (4) Step 2 → Exchange authorization code → copy Refresh token. Use a DIFFERENT token from the read skill — minimum-privilege isolation.

vault_inputs.label: From name (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Display name shown to recipients. Leave blank to use just the email address.
